glosses: A small, open, wheeled vehicle, drawn or pushed by a person or animal, often with two wheels on one axle, more often used for transporting goods than passengers.

examples.text: The grocer delivered his goods by cart.

glosses: A small motor vehicle resembling a car; a go-cart.
A shopping cart.
To carry or convey in a cart.

examples.text: "You had better cart in your crops! To-morrow it'll be snowing!"

glosses: To carry goods.

examples.text: I've been carting these things around all day.

examples.text: Le chariot c est un organe mobile, d’une longueur égale à celle du métier qui s’éloigne et se rapproche des cannelés. Le chariot porte les broches f sur lesquelles a lieu la confection du fil et son renvidage.
